DISCUSSION
D1.
Redevelopment Project Area Bond Issuances (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt the following City Council Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving a housing Tax Allocation Bond (taxable) issuance by the Community Development Commission;
b.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving Bond Anticipation Note (taxable) issuance by the Community Development Commission; and
c.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving Tax Allocation Refunding Bond issuance by the Community Development Commission.
(Recommendation continued on following page)
2.
Adopt the following Community Development Commission Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving the issuance and sale of 2010 housing Tax Allocation Bonds (taxable) for the Redevelopment Project Area and approving related financing documents;
b.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving the issuance and sale of Bond Anticipation Notes (taxable) for the Redevelopment Project Area and related financing documents; and
c.
Resolution No. 2010- , approving the issuance and Sale of Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds for the Redevelopment Project Area and approving related financing documents.
D2.

Receive the report; and

Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2009/2010.
